title: AgentConfigDocument
description: `GET /api/v1/agents/{agentKey}/export` and the body of `POST /api/v1/agents/import` (C4.08): an agent, its engine profile and its own policy layer, to promote between environments. Secrets and bindings are never in it (see PortableAgent); the policy holds only the sections the agent's editors set themselves. An import creates a new agent owned by the importer in the importer's organization and is held to that organization's ceilings.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped on any change an older importer could misread; an importer refuses a version it does not know. 2 (WP-56): the agent carries its own gates (`agent.gates`). 1: before they travelled; its agent has no `gates` and an importer reads it as none.

source.title: AgentConfigSource
source.description: Which definition was exported: a published version (`agentVersion`, with its digest), or the draft (both null). Informational: an import never looks it up.

policy.title: AgentConfigPolicy
policy.description: The agent's own policy layer: the sections its editors set on it (budgets, model routes, durable rollout, catalog approval, tool disclosure, snapshots, locks; and any section an edition adds that its editors set). The org's rules for the agent (approvals) are its admins' and are not carried.

excluded.description: What the source agent had that the document leaves out, so the importer knows to set it: a model account (a credential), sharing, an owner team, running as a service account, and the org's approval rules for it. `gates` appears only in version 1 documents, made before an agent's own gates travelled.
